mermaid:
---
title: OAuth 2 authorization code login with PKCE
---
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor U as User
  participant B as Browser
  participant S as Our SPA
  participant A as Auth server
  participant API as Our API
  U->>B: Click "Sign in"
  B->>S: Sign-in handler
  activate S
  S->>S: Make code_verifier + state
  Note over S: code_challenge = SHA256(code_verifier)
  S->>B: Redirect to /authorize
  deactivate S
  B->>A: GET /authorize (code_challenge, S256, state)
  activate A
  A-->>B: Login and consent page
  U->>B: Enter credentials, consent
  B->>A: POST credentials
  A-->>B: 302 to redirect_uri?code&state
  deactivate A
  B->>S: Load callback with code + state
  activate S
  S->>S: Check state matches
  S->>A: POST /token (code, code_verifier)
  activate A
  A->>A: Verify SHA256(verifier) = challenge
  A-->>S: Access token, ID token, refresh token
  deactivate A
  S->>API: GET /me (Bearer access token)
  activate API
  API->>A: Fetch JWKS (cached)
  A-->>API: Signing keys
  API->>API: Validate signature, aud, exp
  API-->>S: 200 user data
  deactivate API
  deactivate S
